name: Tokyo Dome
description: Summoned Skull gave early OCG decks a 2500 ATK attacker for one Tribute. Magician of Faith could buy back powerful single-use Spells such as Raigeki and Pot of Greed.

defining_cards.name: Summoned Skull
defining_cards.why: A single tribute brought out a 2500 ATK attacker that could break through common 2000 DEF walls.

defining_cards.name: Man-Eater Bug
defining_cards.why: Setting it forced attackers to risk losing a monster to its Flip Effect, even if the Bug lost the battle.

defining_cards.name: Magician of Faith
defining_cards.why: Its Flip Effect recovered a spent Spell, giving decks a second use of cards such as Pot of Greed.

defining_cards.name: Monster Reborn
defining_cards.why: It put a monster from either Graveyard back into play, giving a defeated attacker another Battle Phase.

defining_cards.name: Dark Hole
defining_cards.why: A single Spell could erase the whole monster field, making a set monster and a held attacker a practical route back into a duel.
